free.name: Free
free.description: Essential remote terminal for personal use on 1 connected computer. Local terminal multiplexing and self-hosted relays remain completely free and open.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For individual developers and power users managing multiple cloud instances, workstations, and local machines.

team.name: Team
team.description: For organizations and teams collaborating across fleets of development servers and build runners with unified pooled capacity.

policies.local_and_selfhosted: Local terminal multiplexing, direct LAN connections, and self-hosted relays (FERRYX_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=selfhost) are perpetually free with no license keys or machine limits required.
policies.enrollment_cap: New machine enrollment is blocked immediately when registered machines reach plan capacity (PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED).
policies.grace_period_policy: 7-day grace period for existing accounts entering overdue or over-capacity state before all account-based remote connections (relay and direct streams) are fully stopped at the grace deadline. Local and LAN terminal access is never interrupted.
